opening.argument: The video walks viewers through installing Office 2016: sign in with a Microsoft account, enter a product key, and proceed to the Install Office button. The visible Office setup page shows product-key entry, and the Office account page shows an Install button, matching the spoken walkthrough. The instructions then cover running the installer on a PC or opening it on a Mac. These are concrete installation steps, not a described demand for financial participation. The external support link is presented as help on the same topic; nothing in the supplied account describes a misleading destination. The evidence supports an instructional technology demonstration without establishing any deceptive outcome.

citations.quote: go to. Office.com forward slash setup and sign in with your Microsoft account.
Next enter your product key. This will take you to a page with an Install Office button.
For Mac users, open Finder and go to Downloads. Then double-click the Microsoft Office 2016 installer.
